units.source_text: 有一回我在庙厨后面的旱地里于农活儿，闲时我曾观察蜜蜂造访小朵黄夏菊的情形。

en.t: Once, while I was doing farm work in the dry field behind the temple kitchen, I spent my spare moments watching bees visit the small yellow summer chrysanthemums.

units.source_text: 一只鸣着金翅膀从撒满阳光的天空飞过来的蜜蜂，从许多的夏菊中选中了一朵，在它的前面踌躇了许久许久。

en.t: A bee came flying from the sun-filled sky, its golden wings humming; from among the many summer chrysanthemums it chose one flower, and lingered hesitantly before it for a very long time.
